summary: Per OpenAI's API changelog entry dated Oct 28, 2026, eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers can claim free monthly API credits. Pro gets $100, $200 or $500 per month depending on tier; Business gets $20 per paid Standard seat or $100 per paid Premium seat, pooled and capped at $500 per workspace per month. The subscription must be paid and at least seven days old: free trials, complimentary subscriptions and ChatGPT Enterprise do not qualify. The ChatGPT account and the API account must use the same email address, and you must own both the subscription (or Business workspace) and the API organization. Credits are issued when the subscription renews; unused credits expire at the end of the billing cycle and do not roll over.
claim_steps: Hold a paid ChatGPT Pro or Business subscription that is at least seven days old (not a trial, complimentary plan or Enterprise)
Use the same email address for your ChatGPT account and the API account that owns the receiving organization
Activate the benefit in ChatGPT billing settings or on the API Platform Billing page by linking an API organization you own
Credits are issued automatically when the subscription renews; unused credits expire at the end of each billing cycle

social_proof.title: Changelog
social_proof.text: Eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers can now claim up to $500 per month in free API credits. Activate the benefit from ChatGPT or API Platform by linking an API organization you own.

social_proof.title: API credits for ChatGPT subscribers
social_proof.text: Unused credits expire at the end of the billing cycle and don't roll over. Business API Credits are pooled and capped at $500 per workspace per month.

social_proof.author: OpenAI Developers
social_proof.text: Starting today, eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers can claim up to $500 per month in API credits to build apps and agents.
